scoring_justification: Cannot recompute final quantities from raw simulator output; we compare against paper-reported reference values with tolerances and verify the expected monotonic energy trend.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference storage time and secondary count for 10 keV primary electron
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: 'A 10 keV primary electron will be stored for 3 h. In this timespan it produces ~300 secondaries.'
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from paper text; tolerances set wide (factor ~3.3x) to accommodate independent simulation variations.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported values.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper states storage time and secondary count increase with primary energy; we enforce monotonic ordering.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Derived from paper's qualitative description, implemented as structural check.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Reflects the paper's conclusion about energy dependence.

outputs.description: Quantitative results of the Monte Carlo electron transport simulation: storage time and secondary electron count for each simulated primary electron energy. The values must be non-decreasing with increasing primary energy.

output_contract.notes: The storage_time_hours and secondary_count are expected to be monotonic non-decreasing when energy_keV increases (5 < 10 < 20). The absolute values are compared to a hidden reference derived from the original paper.
